- A growing middle class with improved access to financial credit is increasing discretionary spending on quality interiors, modular furniture and premium plywood.
- The market is shifting from unorganized to organized players who compete on quality standardization, brand-building and distribution network expansion.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Enhance the capacity utilization of existing installed capacity across various product lines to improve the bottom line.
- Continue investing in state-of-the-art machinery, process modernization, and digital integration to optimize operational efficiency, elevate product quality, and future-proof manufacturing infrastructure.
- Conserve and retain profit to further improve capacity utilization and consolidate existing facilities rather than pay dividends.
